size_basis: media bed 7 m2, the anaerobic mineralisation half (A-M-415; A-M-229) (X-FARM sec3)
cad_stl_scope: build solid, metres (X-PAR-04 envelope registry; the rebuild fills the node box 3600 x 2100 x 500 flush)

machine.type: aquaponic root zone B - anaerobic mineralisation media bed (A-M-415; A-M-229): HDPE tray 3600 x 2100 x 500 with the EPDM liner sheet 5 mm, geotextile separation cloth, and the LECA media envelope at the 300 mm depth, 184 mm freeboard to the rim
machine.a_farm: bed area matches the node box - interior 3580 x 2080 = 7.45 m2, drawn at the registry box and NOT shrunk to fit; the liner and the drain are drawn
machine.area_reading: the size_note names the 7 m2 anaerobic half; the design block area_m2 14.56 is the A+B pair - the registry box governs (hold, W12)
machine.zone: anaerobic mineralisation at depth (duty section 3: the bed runs sulfidic); cold rabbit manure lands direct on the media (node design, N3)
machine.material: HDPE tray with EPDM liner, expanded-clay (LECA) media on a geotextile separation cloth, CPVC loop piping

N1.service: nitrate water through the aerobic root zone (plant uptake + anaerobic mineralisation layer)
N1.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

N2.service: loop water to the duckweed raceway (polisher + feed crop)
N2.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the schedule datum z 600 sits at or above the build height 500 - drawn flush at the envelope top (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

N3.service: cold rabbit manure direct to the mineralisation zone
N3.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

N4.note: drain flush at the envelope bottom; the 50 datum is the schedule placeholder at the base

N5.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the schedule datum z 800 predates the build height 500 - drawn flush at the envelope top (hold, W12)

N6.service: press water back to the loop
N6.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

N7.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the schedule datum z 600 sits at or above the build height 500 - drawn flush at the envelope top (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

N8.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the schedule datum z 600 sits at or above the build height 500 - drawn flush at the envelope top (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

N9.service: mineral nitrate solution to the media beds
N9.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric open-bore tube stubs flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: DN15, no flange class, atmospheric tube or hose); inlets N3/N6/N9 on -Y at z 160; the schedule z 600 rows (N1 in, N2/N7/N8 out) and vent N5 (z 800) sit at or above the 500 box - drawn flush at the envelope top (stale datum, hold W12); N4 drain flush at the envelope bottom; no flange drawn (W4 110 % rule); the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text
